category_title: Individuals with SIB who engage in self-restraint to avoid aversive consequences
scenario_title: Functional analysis control condition with preferred items
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a padded treatment room with a therapist and has continuous access to a preferred item during a control condition.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your preferred item. You can play with it while we sit in the room.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the item and crosses her hands tightly across her chest.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can use your hands to play if you want to.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Uncrosses her hands and begins scratching and pinching her arms, then quickly places her hands behind her back.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins hitting herself in the head and banging her helmet against the padded wall, then immediately sits on her hands and holds them under her clothing to restrain them.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is your preferred item. You can play with it while we sit in the room.

STUDENT: (Ignores the item and crosses her hands tightly across her chest.)

TUTOR: You can use your hands to play if you want to.

STUDENT: (Uncrosses her hands and begins scratching and pinching her arms, then quickly places her hands behind her back.)

TUTOR: Let's just sit quietly then.

STUDENT: (Begins hitting herself in the head and banging her helmet against the padded wall, then immediately sits on her hands and holds them under her clothing to restrain them.)

task.content: Participating in the control condition with continuous access to at least one preferred item

context.environment: Padded treatment rooms with a one-way observation window
context.social_setting: Therapist remained in the room with the participant

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During the no-interaction condition and the control condition
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Engaged in self-restraint including sitting on hands, crossing hands across the chest, placing hands behind the back, and holding them within or under clothing (e.g., shirt or pants)
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Self-restraint may occur to avoid aversive consequences produced by SIB

behavior_patterns.condition: In the initial functional analysis where no protective procedures were applied
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Engaged in low but consistent levels of responding across all conditions; SIB may have been suppressed because she engaged in self-restraint

behavior_patterns.condition: In the functional analysis with added protections where a helmet was added
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Engaged in moderate levels of SIB and self-restraint, including head-directed SIB (hitting oneself in the head or banging head against a surface), body-directed SIB, and skin-directed SIB
